settings.appearance.footer: With "System" the app follows iOS light or dark mode, or you can force one. The palette changes the app's main color and background.

settings.list.footer: Movies marked as "watched" are removed automatically after a week. Once removed, they may reappear among recommendations. You can always remove them manually from the list.
settings.intro.footer: Reset the onboarding and watch the intro screens explaining how Mood-E works again.
settings.ads.footer: Open iOS settings to allow or revoke ad tracking. If you turn it off, you'll still see ads, just not personalized ones.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Pick how you feel, what you want from the movie and the era you prefer: Mood-E combines these choices and queries the TMDB database to suggest up to 15 movies matching your mood. With "New picks" you get more titles with the same filters.
faq.q2: Do movies I've already watched keep appearing?
faq.a2: No. When you mark a movie as "Seen it", it's automatically excluded from Home recommendations and Trending. You can review your watched movies in the "My List" tab.
faq.a3: Everything stays on your iPhone: the watchlist and watched movies are saved locally only. No account is needed and no data is sent to external servers.
faq.q4: How do I enable new release notifications?
faq.a4: Go to Settings and turn on "New releases and movies in theatres". You'll get an alert when new movies arrive on TMDB and on the day a movie hits theatres. You can turn them off anytime with the same switch.
faq.q5: Why does "In Theatres" ask for my location?
faq.a5: Your location is only used to show movies playing in your country and cinemas near you via Apple Maps. You can decline with "Not now": in that case the country set on your iPhone is used.
faq.q6: Do trailers open outside the app?
faq.a6: No, trailers always play inside Mood-E in a dedicated window, without ever leaving the app.
faq.q7: Where does the movie data come from?
faq.a7: Titles, posters, ratings and trailers are provided by The Movie Database (TMDB). This app uses TMDB data but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
faq.q8: I found a problem: how do I report it?
faq.a8: From the "Support" section in Settings tap "Report a problem": the GitHub page will open where you can describe the issue or request a new feature. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.
